mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS customerName, DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(o.create_time)) AS rDays, COUNT(o.id) AS fCount, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS mAmount FROM mo_order o LEFT JOIN mo_user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') AND o.delete_status = 0 GROUP BY o.user_id, u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY mAmount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_PAY','PAID','PENDING_SHIP','SHIPPED','RECEIVED','COMPLETED') THEN user_id END) AS orderUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN ('PAID','PENDING_SHIP','SHIPPED','RECEIVED','COMPLETED') THEN user_id END) AS paidUsers FROM mo_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND create_time >= #{since}

SELECT cancel_reason AS reason, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS lostAmount FROM mo_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND status = 'CANCELLED' AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND cancel_reason <> '' AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY cancel_reason ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS payUsers, SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repurchaseUsers FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM mo_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND status IN ('PAID','PENDING_SHIP','SHIPPED','RECEIVED','COMPLETED') AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY user_id ) t
